s0201.literal: On dingmao day the princes Niegube and others were sent back to Karakorum.
s0201.idiomatic: On dingmao day the princes Niegube and others were sent back to Karakorum.

s0202.literal: Barshili's stepmother Maid was enfeoffed as the Emperor's younger sister, Grand Princess of Chang State, and granted a silver seal.
s0202.idiomatic: Barshili's stepmother Maid was enfeoffed as the Emperor's younger sister, Grand Princess of Chang State, and granted a silver seal.

s0203.literal: Huzhamudin was made Qazaq of the Qazaqs, in charge of Western Regions household registration.
s0203.idiomatic: Huzhamudin was made Qazaq of the Qazaqs, in charge of Western Regions household registration.

s0204.literal: On xinwei day the lunar eclipse reached totality.
s0204.idiomatic: On xinwei day the lunar eclipse reached totality.

s0205.literal: On guiyou day crown prince household steward Tumandi'er was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0205.idiomatic: On guiyou day crown prince household steward Tumandi'er was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0206.literal: On jiaxu day spell-masters were ordered to perform Buddhist rites to avert thunder.
s0206.idiomatic: On jiaxu day spell-masters were ordered to perform Buddhist rites to avert thunder.

s0207.literal: On gengchen day, because of violent winds, a lunar eclipse, and an earthquake, the Emperor personally wrote an edict admonishing the hundred officials.
s0207.idiomatic: On gengchen day, because of violent winds, a lunar eclipse, and an earthquake, the Emperor personally wrote an edict admonishing the hundred officials.

s0208.literal: On xinsi day the new hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.
s0208.idiomatic: On xinsi day the new hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.

s0209.literal: The Mulinsa'erban tribe and northern frontier Mongol households suffered famine; relief grain and notes were granted in varying amounts.
s0209.idiomatic: The Mulinsa'erban tribe and northern frontier Mongol households suffered famine; relief grain and notes were granted in varying amounts.

s0210.literal: Subordinate counties of Jiangling Route suffered famine; Zhongqing and Kunming garrison farms in Yunnan suffered flooding.
s0210.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Jiangling Route suffered famine; Zhongqing and Kunming garrison farms in Yunnan suffered flooding.

s0211.literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day surveillance censors Dong Pengnan, Liu Qian, Bian Si, Mu Wan, and Shaban memorialized regarding calamities and portents: "Grand councillor Naimantai, Director of the Palace Buildings office commissioner Tiemur Buqa, and household steward Tuman Da'er allied with the rebels and failed in ministerial integrity; the Director of Ceremonial was not careful in guarding the temples; the Prince of Liao killed a kinsman without authorization; Buqa and Jieli used false orders to disrupt the law — all were leniently spared; this is a serious failure of punishment; we request their crimes be fixed to dispel Heaven's changes.
s0211.idiomatic: Fifth month, on dinghai day surveillance censors Dong Pengnan, Liu Qian, Bian Si, Mu Wan, and Shaban memorialized regarding calamities and portents: "Grand councillor Naimantai, Director of the Palace Buildings office commissioner Tiemur Buqa, and household steward Tuman Da'er allied with the rebels and failed in ministerial integrity; the Director of Ceremonial was not careful in guarding the temples; the Prince of Liao killed a kinsman without authorization; Buqa and Jieli used false orders to disrupt the law — all were leniently spared; this is a serious failure of punishment; we request their crimes be fixed to dispel Heaven's changes.

s0213.literal: On jichou day the Emperor instructed Daolisha: "Since We acceded to the throne, not a single person has been able to uphold established law and speak to Us about it.
s0213.idiomatic: On jichou day the Emperor instructed Daolisha: "Since We acceded to the throne, not a single person has been able to uphold established law and speak to Us about it.

s0214.literal: To know yet not speak is disloyalty, and moreover traps people in guilt.
s0214.idiomatic: To know yet not speak is disloyalty, and moreover traps people in guilt.

s0215.literal: From this forward, whatever you know, you should all report it, so that We clearly know the law and dare not indulge Ourselves.
s0215.idiomatic: From this forward, whatever you know, you should all report it, so that We clearly know the law and dare not indulge Ourselves.

s0216.literal: Not Ourselves alone — if all affairs under Heaven are carried out by observing the law, then all will be well governed; otherwise the realm will suffer distress.
s0216.idiomatic: Not Ourselves alone — if all affairs under Heaven are carried out by observing the law, then all will be well governed; otherwise the realm will suffer distress.

s0217.literal: " He further said: "In all matters, guarding against them when small is easy; remedying them when great is hard — you should clearly proclaim Our words to the multitude, so they know what to heed.
s0217.idiomatic: " He further said: "In all matters, guarding against them when small is easy; remedying them when great is hard — you should clearly proclaim Our words to the multitude, so they know what to heed.

s0218.literal: " On renchen day censorate officials Tuhulu and Niuze, speaking for the censors, said: "Calamities and portents have repeatedly appeared; the chancellor should yield his position to respond to Heaven's changes — whether this is suitable rests with Your sacred judgment.
s0218.idiomatic: " On renchen day censorate officials Tuhulu and Niuze, speaking for the censors, said: "Calamities and portents have repeatedly appeared; the chancellor should yield his position to respond to Heaven's changes — whether this is suitable rests with Your sacred judgment.

s0219.literal: As for us subjects, serving as Your Majesty's eyes and ears, we have been unable to investigate those who practiced favoritism and violated the law; negligent in office, we should first step aside to yield place to the worthy and capable.
s0219.idiomatic: As for us subjects, serving as Your Majesty's eyes and ears, we have been unable to investigate those who practiced favoritism and violated the law; negligent in office, we should first step aside to yield place to the worthy and capable.

s0220.literal: " The Emperor said: "What the censors say — the fault lies with Us; why need you all be so hasty!
s0220.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "What the censors say — the fault lies with Us; why need you all be so hasty!

s0221.literal: " Tuhulu further said: "Your subject is already old and ill, fearing he may harm great affairs — I beg to retire first.
s0221.idiomatic: " Tuhulu further said: "Your subject is already old and ill, fearing he may harm great affairs — I beg to retire first.

s0222.literal: " Thereupon central secretariat officials Uburdula, Zhang Gui, and Yang Tingyu all submitted memorials requesting dismissal.
s0222.idiomatic: " Thereupon central secretariat officials Uburdula, Zhang Gui, and Yang Tingyu all submitted memorials requesting dismissal.

s0223.literal: Chancellors Xumaijie and Daolisha said: "Recently with calamities and portents, Your Majesty, concerned for the realm, turned inward in self-reproach, reverently following our forebears' holy instruction, cultivating virtue and careful conduct, directing us ministers each to diligently fulfill our duties — the personally written edict reached Dadu, and the officials left in charge all pleaded guilty and impeached themselves.
s0223.idiomatic: Chancellors Xumaijie and Daolisha said: "Recently with calamities and portents, Your Majesty, concerned for the realm, turned inward in self-reproach, reverently following our forebears' holy instruction, cultivating virtue and careful conduct, directing us ministers each to diligently fulfill our duties — the personally written edict reached Dadu, and the officials left in charge all pleaded guilty and impeached themselves.

s0224.literal: We who serve as left and right chancellors are low in talent and dull in understanding; bearing the great charge of governing the state, we have offered no assistance, thereby bringing on calamity — the guilt lies with us; we are the ones who should be dismissed and removed; what guilt have the other ministers?
s0224.idiomatic: We who serve as left and right chancellors are low in talent and dull in understanding; bearing the great charge of governing the state, we have offered no assistance, thereby bringing on calamity — the guilt lies with us; we are the ones who should be dismissed and removed; what guilt have the other ministers?

s0225.literal: " The Emperor said: "If you all withdraw and leave, with whom shall We deliberate on the state's great affairs?
s0225.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "If you all withdraw and leave, with whom shall We deliberate on the state's great affairs?

s0226.literal: You should each persuade one another to encourage the fulfillment of your duties."
s0226.idiomatic: You should each persuade one another to encourage the fulfillment of your duties."

s0227.literal: On wuxu day the spirit tablets of successive sage emperors were moved to the Imperial Ancestral Temple's new hall.
s0227.idiomatic: On wuxu day the spirit tablets of successive sage emperors were moved to the Imperial Ancestral Temple's new hall.

s0228.literal: On xinchou day Yao raiders at Xunzhou attacked Changle County.
s0228.idiomatic: On xinchou day Yao raiders at Xunzhou attacked Changle County.

s0229.literal: On jiachen day prisoners at Shangdu guilty of beating-punishment offenses and below were pardoned.
s0229.idiomatic: On jiachen day prisoners at Shangdu guilty of beating-punishment offenses and below were pardoned.

s0230.literal: On bingwu day Venus encroached upon Ghost.
s0230.idiomatic: On bingwu day Venus encroached upon Ghost.

s0231.literal: Attendant censor Gao Kui submitted a memorial requesting plain speaking, distinguishing the wicked from the upright, and clarifying rewards and punishments; the Emperor approved his words and granted silver and silk.
s0231.idiomatic: Attendant censor Gao Kui submitted a memorial requesting plain speaking, distinguishing the wicked from the upright, and clarifying rewards and punishments; the Emperor approved his words and granted silver and silk.

s0232.literal: On dingwei day Venus encroached upon Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi.
s0232.idiomatic: On dingwei day Venus encroached upon Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi.

s0233.literal: On jiyou day Fang Er and others of Binzhou became bandits; the authorities captured them.
s0233.idiomatic: On jiyou day Fang Er and others of Binzhou became bandits; the authorities captured them.

s0234.literal: On guichou day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.
s0234.idiomatic: On guichou day the Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to observe a comet.

s0235.literal: Central secretariat grand councillor Tumandi'er and the crown prince household steward deputy who also headed the Directorate of the Palace Buildings office, Huihui, requested that following Prince Yuzong's precedent, eminent Confucian scholars be selected to assist the crown prince; an edict directed central secretariat officials to seek them out and report.
s0235.idiomatic: Central secretariat grand councillor Tumandi'er and the crown prince household steward deputy who also headed the Directorate of the Palace Buildings office, Huihui, requested that following Prince Yuzong's precedent, eminent Confucian scholars be selected to assist the crown prince; an edict directed central secretariat officials to seek them out and report.

s0236.literal: Yuanzhou suffered fire; subordinate counties of Longqing, Yan'an, Ji'an, Hangzhou, Dadu and other routes suffered flooding; the people were famine-stricken; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
s0236.idiomatic: Yuanzhou suffered fire; subordinate counties of Longqing, Yan'an, Ji'an, Hangzhou, Dadu and other routes suffered flooding; the people were famine-stricken; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

s0237.literal: Sixth month, on yimao new moon, Prince Kuokuochu was dispatched to guard the Uighurs and granted gold, silver, and notes numbering in the thousands.
s0237.idiomatic: Sixth month, on yimao new moon, Prince Kuokuochu was dispatched to guard the Uighurs and granted gold, silver, and notes numbering in the thousands.

s0238.literal: On wuwu day Zhaoming Luo Jiu and others, chiefs of Gaolanshenchang Stockade in Menghua Prefecture, Yunnan, raided Weichu.
s0238.idiomatic: On wuwu day Zhaoming Luo Jiu and others, chiefs of Gaolanshenchang Stockade in Menghua Prefecture, Yunnan, raided Weichu.

s0239.literal: On gengshen day Zhang Gui arrived from Dadu and, speaking on behalf of the officials left in charge who had assembled to deliberate, said: "The rebel faction has not been suppressed; wicked men have not been removed; loyal indignation has not been vindicated; wrongs have not been redressed; government orders lack credibility; rewards and punishments are unjust; levies are unequal; expenditures are uncontrolled — we request these be judged and decided.
s0239.idiomatic: On gengshen day Zhang Gui arrived from Dadu and, speaking on behalf of the officials left in charge who had assembled to deliberate, said: "The rebel faction has not been suppressed; wicked men have not been removed; loyal indignation has not been vindicated; wrongs have not been redressed; government orders lack credibility; rewards and punishments are unjust; levies are unequal; expenditures are uncontrolled — we request these be judged and decided.

s0241.literal: Prince Amoge died; one thousand ingots of notes were granted as funeral gifts.
s0241.idiomatic: Prince Amoge died; 1,000 ingots of notes were granted as funeral gifts.

s0242.literal: Princes Kunche and Yiligichi came to court.
s0242.idiomatic: Princes Kunche and Yiligichi came to court.

s0243.literal: Thirteen thousand ingots of notes were granted to the departments of imperial sons-in-law Tiemur and others; sixteen thousand eighty ingots of notes to northern frontier garrison troops.
s0243.idiomatic: 13,000 ingots of notes were granted to the departments of imperial sons-in-law Tiemur and others; 16,080 ingots of notes to northern frontier garrison troops.

s0244.literal: Mongol famine refugees were relieved and sent back to their departments.
s0244.idiomatic: Mongol famine refugees were relieved and sent back to their departments.

s0245.literal: Yan'an Route suffered famine; wine was prohibited.
s0245.idiomatic: Yan'an Route suffered famine; wine was prohibited.

s0246.literal: On guihai day mosques were built at Shangdu and Datong Route; forty thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0246.idiomatic: On guihai day mosques were built at Shangdu and Datong Route; 40,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0247.literal: On bingyin day envoys were dispatched to summon and instruct Zambla.
s0247.idiomatic: On bingyin day envoys were dispatched to summon and instruct Zambla.

s0248.literal: Kuokuochu and others were dispatched to Goryeo to obtain thirty women.
s0248.idiomatic: Kuokuochu and others were dispatched to Goryeo to obtain 30 women.

s0249.literal: Huang Shengxu and Cen Shixing of the Left and Right Two Rivers in Guangxi requested to send their sons and younger brothers on tribute missions; this was granted.
s0249.idiomatic: Huang Shengxu and Cen Shixing of the Left and Right Two Rivers in Guangxi requested to send their sons and younger brothers on tribute missions; this was granted.

s0250.literal: On dingmao day the Great Tent Hall was completed; the Thunder-Calming Tranquility Buddhist Monastery was built.
s0250.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Great Tent Hall was completed; the Thunder-Calming Tranquility Buddhist Monastery was built.

s0251.literal: On gengwu day the Hailatu Garrison Farm General Commissionerate was established.
s0251.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Hailatu Garrison Farm General Commissionerate was established.

s0252.literal: On xinwei day Black Yaman Dagha Buddhist rites were performed at the Crystal Hall.
s0252.idiomatic: On xinwei day Black Yaman Dagha Buddhist rites were performed at the Crystal Hall.

s0253.literal: On guiyou day the Emperor received Buddhist precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.
s0253.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor received Buddhist precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.

s0254.literal: On jimao day Prince Kebek and others dispatched their kinsmen Tiemur Buqa and others, presenting tame leopards and western horses in court tribute.
s0254.idiomatic: On jimao day Prince Kebek and others dispatched their kinsmen Tiemur Buqa and others, presenting tame leopards and western horses in court tribute.

s0255.literal: Edict: "Review and release imprisoned detainees; show care for soldiers; remit government purchase and miscellaneous corvée throughout the realm for three years; remit diver households' assessed taxes for one year.
s0255.idiomatic: Edict: "Review and release imprisoned detainees; show care for soldiers; remit government purchase and miscellaneous corvée throughout the realm for 3 years; remit diver households' assessed taxes for 1 year.

s0256.literal: Officials of fourth rank and below are uniformly granted one grade of honorary rank; third rank advances one step in succession.
s0256.idiomatic: Officials of fourth rank and below are uniformly granted one grade of honorary rank; third rank advances one step in succession.

s0257.literal: Those who served in distant malarial regions and died without being able to return home for burial, whose wives and children were cast adrift — the authorities shall provide funds and send them back; this shall additionally be codified as a statute.
s0257.idiomatic: Those who served in distant malarial regions and died without being able to return home for burial, whose wives and children were cast adrift — the authorities shall provide funds and send them back; this shall additionally be codified as a statute.

s0258.literal: " Ninang of Dali Route, Yunnan, became bandits.
s0258.idiomatic: " Ninang of Dali Route, Yunnan, became bandits.

s0259.literal: The capital, Jin Prefecture and Shen Prefecture of Zhending, various routes of Fengyuan, and places such as Gansu's canal garrison farms — rain damaged crops; two months' relief grain was granted.
s0259.idiomatic: The capital, Jin Prefecture and Shen Prefecture of Zhending, various routes of Fengyuan, and places such as Gansu's canal garrison farms — rain damaged crops; 2 months' relief grain was granted.

s0260.literal: Grand Secretariat of Agriculture garrison farms, various guard garrison farms, Zhangde, Bianliang and other routes — rain damaged crops; twenty-one prefectures including Shunde, Daming, Hejian, and Dongping suffered locusts; Jinning, Gongchang, Changde, Longxing and other places suffered famine — in all cases grain was issued for relief.
s0260.idiomatic: Grand Secretariat of Agriculture garrison farms, various guard garrison farms, Zhangde, Bianliang and other routes — rain damaged crops; 21 prefectures including Shunde, Daming, Hejian, and Dongping suffered locusts; Jinning, Gongchang, Changde, Longxing and other places suffered famine — in all cases grain was issued for relief.

s0261.literal: The Hunyuan River at Datong, Hutuo River at Zhending, Wei River and Heishui in Shaanxi, and Jiang River at Quzhou all overflowed, likewise sweeping away civilian dwellings.
s0261.idiomatic: The Hunyuan River at Datong, Hutuo River at Zhending, Wei River and Heishui in Shaanxi, and Jiang River at Quzhou all overflowed, likewise sweeping away civilian dwellings.

s0262.literal: Xuande Prefecture, Gongchang Route, and places such as the Eight Circuits Jinshi Fan suffered hail from rain.
s0262.idiomatic: Xuande Prefecture, Gongchang Route, and places such as the Eight Circuits Jinshi Fan suffered hail from rain.

s0263.literal: Hejian, Jinning, Jingzhou, Yangzhou, Shouchun and other routes; garrison farms in Huguang and Henan — all suffered drought.
s0263.idiomatic: Hejian, Jinning, Jingzhou, Yangzhou, Shouchun and other routes; garrison farms in Huguang and Henan — all suffered drought.

s0264.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day Yang Dache of Pingcha in Sizhou and Ran Shichang of Youyang Prefecture raided stockades including Xiaoshiye and Kaijiang; troops were mobilized to capture them.
s0264.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day Yang Dache of Pingcha in Sizhou and Ran Shichang of Youyang Prefecture raided stockades including Xiaoshiye and Kaijiang; troops were mobilized to capture them.

s0265.literal: Prince Ama died; five thousand ingots of notes were granted as funeral gifts.
s0265.idiomatic: Prince Ama died; 5,000 ingots of notes were granted as funeral gifts.

s0266.literal: Two thousand ingots of notes were granted to Yunnan King Wang Chan; three thousand ingots of notes to Prince Aduchi.
s0266.idiomatic: 2,000 ingots of notes were granted to Yunnan King Wang Chan; 3,000 ingots of notes to Prince Aduchi.

s0268.literal: Ship-ling, Yining, Lingchuan and other Yao districts were summoned and instructed.
s0268.idiomatic: Ship-ling, Yining, Lingchuan and other Yao districts were summoned and instructed.

s0269.literal: On gengyin day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.
s0269.idiomatic: On gengyin day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.

s0270.literal: On bingshen day Prince Xiechetu inherited command of his father Wanzhe's following and was still granted the former seal.
s0270.idiomatic: On bingshen day Prince Xiechetu inherited command of his father Wanzhe's following and was still granted the former seal.

s0271.literal: On jihai day Mongol refugee populations were relieved; two hundred ninety thousand ingots of notes were granted and they were sent back; it was further forbidden to leave their departments without authorization — violators were beheaded.
s0271.idiomatic: On jihai day Mongol refugee populations were relieved; 290,000 ingots of notes were granted and they were sent back; it was further forbidden to leave their departments without authorization — violators were beheaded.

s0272.literal: On gengzi day Prince Bayan Temür was dispatched to guard the eastern part of Kulen; Alana Shili was dispatched to guard Shazhou; each was granted three thousand ingots of notes.
s0272.idiomatic: On gengzi day Prince Bayan Temür was dispatched to guard the eastern part of Kulen; Alana Shili was dispatched to guard Shazhou; each was granted 3,000 ingots of notes.

s0273.literal: Satemishi led guard soldiers to assist Grand Preceptor Anta on a frontier tour; one thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0273.idiomatic: Satemishi led guard soldiers to assist Grand Preceptor Anta on a frontier tour; 1,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0274.literal: On guimao day pearl-collection diver households in Guangzhou, Fujian and other places were abolished and made commoners; their assessed taxes were still remitted for one year.
s0274.idiomatic: On guimao day pearl-collection diver households in Guangzhou, Fujian and other places were abolished and made commoners; their assessed taxes were still remitted for 1 year.

s0275.literal: On bingwu day the Western scriptures were translated using Uighur script.
s0275.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Western scriptures were translated using Uighur script.

s0276.literal: On dingwei day a comet was observed at the Shangdu Directorate of Astronomy.
s0276.idiomatic: On dingwei day a comet was observed at the Shangdu Directorate of Astronomy.

s0277.literal: Shandong Salt Transport Commission vice commissioner Mahemo was made Minister of Personnel, wearing a tiger tally; Hanlin compiler Yang Zongrui was made Bureau Director of Rites, wearing a gold tally — sent to proclaim the accession edict and instruct Annam.
s0277.idiomatic: Shandong Salt Transport Commission vice commissioner Mahemo was made Minister of Personnel, wearing a tiger tally; Hanlin compiler Yang Zongrui was made Bureau Director of Rites, wearing a gold tally — sent to proclaim the accession edict and instruct Annam.

s0278.literal: Changqing Monastery was established; the eunuch Ayibo was made monastery director.
s0278.idiomatic: Changqing Monastery was established; the eunuch Ayibo was made monastery director.

s0279.literal: The Central Auspicious Office was abolished.
s0279.idiomatic: The Central Auspicious Office was abolished.

s0280.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Crown prince guard soldiers — in the previous reign there were only three thousand; now they have increased to seventeen thousand; we request the crown prince household be ordered to cull them and restore the old system.
s0280.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Crown prince guard soldiers — in the previous reign there were only 3,000; now they have increased to 17,000; we request the crown prince household be ordered to cull them and restore the old system.

s0282.literal: On wushen day the confiscated property of Tiemudier and his sons Bandan and Guanyinnu was returned to their families.
s0282.idiomatic: On wushen day the confiscated property of Tiemudier and his sons Bandan and Guanyinnu was returned to their families.

s0283.literal: Chaoyi County of Fengyuan Route, Chuqiu County of Cao Prefecture, and Puyang County of Kai Prefecture in Daming Route — rivers overflowed; the Qing River at Gu'an Prefecture in Dadu Route overflowed; the Sha, Feng, and Ming rivers at Ren County in Shunde Route overflowed; eleven prefectures including Zhending, Guangping, and Luz suffered rain-damaged crops; Longqing Prefecture had hail as large as chicken eggs, three chi deep on level ground; the Tun River at Ding Prefecture overflowed and mountains collapsed — canal garrison farm rent was remitted.
s0283.idiomatic: Chaoyi County of Fengyuan Route, Chuqiu County of Cao Prefecture, and Puyang County of Kai Prefecture in Daming Route — rivers overflowed; the Qing River at Gu'an Prefecture in Dadu Route overflowed; the Sha, Feng, and Ming rivers at Ren County in Shunde Route overflowed; 11 prefectures including Zhending, Guangping, and Luz suffered rain-damaged crops; Longqing Prefecture had hail as large as chicken eggs, 3 chi deep on level ground; the Tun River at Ding Prefecture overflowed and mountains collapsed — canal garrison farm rent was remitted.

s0284.literal: The capital, Gongchang, Yan'an, Jining, Longxing and other places suffered famine; grain was sold at reduced prices for relief in varying amounts.
s0284.idiomatic: The capital, Gongchang, Yan'an, Jining, Longxing and other places suffered famine; grain was sold at reduced prices for relief in varying amounts.

s0285.literal: Pan Fujuan and other Yao chiefs of Qingyuan in Guangxi led their followers to submit; they were appointed as recorders, wardens, and other officials in varying grades.
s0285.idiomatic: Pan Fujuan and other Yao chiefs of Qingyuan in Guangxi led their followers to submit; they were appointed as recorders, wardens, and other officials in varying grades.

s0286.literal: The former Marquis of Pingyang in Wenzhou was additionally enfeoffed as Marquis Yinglie.
s0286.idiomatic: The former Marquis of Pingyang in Wenzhou was additionally enfeoffed as Marquis Yinglie.

s0287.literal: Eighth month, on jiayin day five thousand impoverished persons in the lands of Cheche'er and Huo'erhuosi were granted two months' relief grain.
s0287.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiayin day 5,000 impoverished persons in the lands of Cheche'er and Huo'erhuosi were granted 2 months' relief grain.

s0288.literal: On yimao day an edict directed that criminal cases again be subordinated to the Court of the Imperial Clan, following Emperor Shizu's old system; the Ministry of Justice was not to participate.
s0288.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict directed that criminal cases again be subordinated to the Court of the Imperial Clan, following Emperor Shizu's old system; the Ministry of Justice was not to participate.

s0289.literal: On bingchen day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was offered to.
s0289.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was offered to.

s0290.literal: On dingsi day one thousand five hundred ingots of notes each were granted to Princes Balitai and Huangtou.
s0290.idiomatic: On dingsi day 1,500 ingots of notes each were granted to Princes Balitai and Huangtou.

s0291.literal: Speaking of matters before the amnesty was forbidden.
s0291.idiomatic: Speaking of matters before the amnesty was forbidden.

s0292.literal: On gengshen day ten thousand mares were purchased to obtain kumiss.
s0292.idiomatic: On gengshen day 10,000 mares were purchased to obtain kumiss.

s0293.literal: Relay households at Tieliegan, Mulun and other stations were granted relief grain and notes in varying amounts.
s0293.idiomatic: Relay households at Tieliegan, Mulun and other stations were granted relief grain and notes in varying amounts.

s0294.literal: On xinhai day Hanlin academician-director Wochi was dispatched to sacrifice to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong at Pujing Monastery.
s0294.idiomatic: On xinhai day Hanlin academician-director Wochi was dispatched to sacrifice to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong at Pujing Monastery.

s0295.literal: Prince Tuotiemuer was granted three thousand ingots of notes.
s0295.idiomatic: Prince Tuotiemuer was granted 3,000 ingots of notes.

s0296.literal: On gengwu day the empress's palace Golden Ridge Hall was built.
s0296.idiomatic: On gengwu day the empress's palace Golden Ridge Hall was built.

s0297.literal: On xinwei day eleven painted images of Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa were distributed to each branch secretariat, ordering them sculpted and worshipped.
s0297.idiomatic: On xinwei day 11 painted images of Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa were distributed to each branch secretariat, ordering them sculpted and worshipped.

s0298.literal: An edict directed that military officers guilty of crimes who held commission by regulation were to be reported; those with edict-granted commission were to be adjudicated by the branch secretariat.
s0298.idiomatic: An edict directed that military officers guilty of crimes who held commission by regulation were to be reported; those with edict-granted commission were to be adjudicated by the branch secretariat.

s0299.literal: The wine tax of the Jinquan lodge was granted to Princess Shouning.
s0299.idiomatic: The wine tax of the Jinquan lodge was granted to Princess Shouning.

s0300.literal: On dingchou day the Yuquan River dredging corvée was halted.
s0300.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Yuquan River dredging corvée was halted.
